versions.changelog:
Initial release of InvoiceGuard, an AI-driven invoice compliance tool:

- Supports upload and recognition of invoices in images, PDF, OFD, and XML formats.
- Implements multi-method AI deduplication: field, hash, and image-based duplicate detection.
- Integrates official State Tax Administration verification (Pro).
- Generates structured compliance reports per Cai Hui Ban [2023] No.18 (Pro), with Feishu document and Bitable integration.
- Enables batch invoice processing with deduplication, verification, and reporting workflows.
- Offers privacy by processing and discarding invoice data immediately.
